concept: Sunny-morning breakfast warmth: golden maple-syrup amber and caramel pour over creamy buttermilk backgrounds, anchored by cozy warm-brown ink and a cheerful berry-red accent. Homey, appetizing, and bright like a stack of pancakes at sunrise.
